defaultDescription: No description for this scene yet.

descriptions.Box2D: Physics with JBox2D: bodies and shapes in a world, with a camera that moves, zooms and drags.
descriptions.CollisionGridScene2D: Collision2DGrid: obstacles sorted into the cells of a grid, only the ones near the rectangle that follows the mouse are tested. Grey: ignored, blue: tested, red: colliding.
descriptions.CommandsScene2D: A scene with its own command, spawn, that creates shapes. Open the console with the key left of 1 and try: spawn 3 --color red
descriptions.ConsoleFeedScene: Writes a line of every type in the console at a regular pace, to try scrolling, filters and selection while the log moves.
descriptions.DisplayModesScene: Windowed, exclusive fullscreen and borderless modes, a second window, the border and the resizing.
descriptions.DocumentationScene: The reference scene: read its source code, each step of the life of a scene and of its resources is explained.
descriptions.FallbackScene: Resources that can't be used (unknown texture, missing file, unknown font or sound) are replaced by fallbacks instead of crashing the game.
descriptions.Game3D2D: A 2D animated slime drawn in a 3D scene, next to a textured cube, with a free camera.
descriptions.GamepadScene: One square per player, moved by the sticks of up to four gamepads, with the list of the buttons and axes.
descriptions.GLLoading: Loads several big generated textures, sent to the GPU by strips with the time left in each frame, so the game keeps running.
descriptions.GUIWidgetsScene: Sliders, a selector, a shaking effect and a positional sound that follows a moving square.
descriptions.MultiWindowScene: Several windows: a dialog that blocks the main one, a tool window and a second context with its own scene.
descriptions.PathfindingScene2D: Graph, Dijkstra and A*: paint walls with the mouse, move the start and the end, and see the shortest path.
descriptions.Platformer2D.PlatformerBox2D: A platformer: a player controlled on JBox2D physics.
descriptions.PreloadScene: Loads the next scene in advance while this one runs, so Enter switches with a short loading screen.
descriptions.RopeSimulation2D: A rope simulation driven by the mouse.
descriptions.Scene2D: The main 2D test scene: tile map, animations and texts.
descriptions.Scene3D: The main 3D test scene: cubes and models lit by several lights, with a free camera.
descriptions.Scene3DBis: A second 3D test scene with cubes and lights.
descriptions.SoundFormatsScene: The same sound in each supported format (ogg, wav, mp3, flac), played when the mouse enters its line.
descriptions.TerrainGeneration3D: A generated terrain seen with a free camera.
descriptions.TextFieldScene2D: The TextField and the focus of the window: while the field has the focus, the scene sees no key.
descriptions.TextPaddingScene: The padding of a Text, and a long text wrapped at the spaces with setMaxWidth.
descriptions.WaveFunctionCollapse2D: A map generated by the Wave Function Collapse algorithm from the rules of a tile set.
